---
title: "LMM_psd95"
---

```{r}
# Load required packages
library(lme4)        # For lmer
library(lmerTest)    # For p-values (Satterthwaite approximation)
library(dplyr)       # For data manipulation
library(readxl)      # Already using for read_excel/read_xlsx
library(emmeans)     # For post-hoc tests
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Load Data (as in your code - assuming already run)
 psd95 <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/PSD95_CpGs_mit_verhalten_größer_umstrukturiert.xlsx"))
# ==============================================================
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 1. Filter to Specific CpGs of Interest
# ==============================================================
# Assuming "filter for" means keep only these CpGs (e.g., for focused analysis)
# If you meant exclude them, change to !CpG_Position %in% ...
psd95_specific <- psd95 %>%
  filter(CpG_Position %in% c("p95", "p60", "p23"))
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 2. Preprocessing: Identify and Exclude Invariant/Low-Variability CpGs (among the specific ones)
# ==============================================================

# Compute summary stats per CpG across ALL samples
cpg_summary <- psd95_specific %>%
  group_by(CpG_Position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meth = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_meth = min(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_meth = max(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_meth = max_meth - min_meth,
    is_invariant = (sd_meth == 0 | range_meth < 0.05)  # Threshold: SD=0 or range<5%
  )

# Print to inspect
print(cpg_summary)

# Filter data to exclude invariant CpGs (if any among the 3)
psd95_filtered <- psd95_specific %>%
  inner_join(cpg_summary %>% filter(!is_invariant) %>% select(CpG_Position), by = "CpG_Position")
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 3. Compute Gene-Level Average Methylation per Subject-Time-Group (across the selected CpGs)
# ==============================================================

psd95_avg <- psd95_filtered %>%
  group_by(ID, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Age_start, Sex) %>%  # Include key covariates; adjust if column names differ
  summarise(
    avg_meth = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),  # Average across remaining CpGs
    n_CpG = n(),                                 # Count of CpGs used (for QC)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure proportion 0-1 (assuming methylation is 0-1; if %, divide by 100)
    avg_prop = avg_meth,  # If already 0-1; else avg_meth / 100
    
    # M-value transformation with pseudocount (0.01 is robust)
    M_value = log2( (avg_prop + 0.01) / (1 - avg_prop + 0.01) )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_CpG >= 1)  # Ensure at least 1 CpG per average

# Inspect the averaged data
summary(psd95_avg)
head(psd95_avg)
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 4. Prepare Factors for Modeling
# ==============================================================

psd95_avg <- psd95_avg %>%
  mutate(
    Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0", "T1", "T2")),  # Adjust levels to your time points
    Gruppe = factor(Gruppe, levels = c("Controll", "Piano"))       # Adjust to your group names
  )
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 5. Fit the Linear Mixed Model (LMM) on M-values
# ==============================================================

# Basic model: time * group + random intercept for subject
model_basic <- lmer(M_value ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + (1 | ID), 
                    data = psd95_avg)

# Summary and ANOVA
summary(model_basic)
anova(model_basic)  # Type III with Satterthwaite

# Adjusted model: Add covariates like age and sex
model_adjusted <- lmer(M_value ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID), 
                       data = psd95_avg)

# Summary and ANOVA for adjusted model
summary(model_adjusted)
anova(model_adjusted)

# Compare models (if needed)
anova(model_basic, model_adjusted)  # Use AIC/BIC to choose
```
```{r}
report(model_basic)
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 6. Post-Hoc Tests (on the adjusted model)
# ==============================================================

# Interaction effects: Changes over time within groups
emmeans(model_adjusted, pairwise ~ Zeitpunkt | Gruppe)

# Group differences at each time point
emmeans(model_adjusted, pairwise ~ Gruppe | Zeitpunkt)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Diagnostics: Check Residuals, Normality, etc.
# ==============================================================

# Residual plots
plot(model_adjusted)  # Basic residual vs fitted

# QQ plot for normality
qqnorm(resid(model_adjusted))
qqline(resid(model_adjusted))
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Optional: Per-CpG Analysis (if you want site-specific instead of average)
# ==============================================================
# Fit separate models for each of the 3 CpGs (after excluding invariants)

for (cpg in unique(psd95_filtered$CpG_Position)) {
  df_cpg <- psd95_filtered %>%
    filter(CpG_Position == cpg) %>%
    mutate(
      prop = methylation,  # Assume 0-1
      M_value = log2( (prop + 0.01) / (1 - prop + 0.01) ),
      Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0", "T1", "T2")),
      Gruppe = factor(Gruppe, levels = c("Controll", "Piano"))
    )
  
  model_cpg <- lmer(M_value ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID), 
                    data = df_cpg)
  
  print(paste("Model for CpG:", cpg))
  print(summary(model_cpg))
  print(anova(model_cpg))
}
```

```{r}
# report(model_cpg)
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Alternative: Beta Mixed Model (if M-value residuals are poor)
# ==============================================================
library(glmmTMB)

# For average (adjust prop for beta)
psd95_avg <- psd95_avg %>%
  mutate(
    prop_adj = (avg_prop * (n_CpG - 1) + 0.5) / n_CpG
  )

model_beta <- glmmTMB(prop_adj ~ Zeitpunkt * Gruppe + Age_start + Sex + (1 | ID),
                      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
                      data = psd95_avg)

summary(model_beta)
```
```{r}
report(model_beta)
```
